changelog: Scanning a QR code now opens the design's Device Ready to Connect confirmation, with the model and serial and a Rescan / Connect Device pair, instead of a card over the camera.
The QR screen itself matches A_1.3.1: centred title, a 306pt viewfinder, the caption under it, and failures in the standard bottom toast.

Name Your Device and Choose an Icon take the frames' centred 24pt headline, the shared text field, the eight handoff tiles and a 44pt action button; the model picker the design does not have is gone, and the model is read off the scan instead.
Found-device rows are 68pt with a plain section label and the frame's outlined Connect button, and a connect failure shows in the bottom toast.
Icon slot 6 is the power-strip glyph the frames draw, in both the setup grid and Display Icon.
